Hardware-aware presets ensure consistent performance across device generations.
*   **When to Use:** Real-time visualization of voxel-based worlds on iOS/macOS devices with Metal support.
*   **When Not to Use:** Non-Apple platforms, or scenes requiring dynamic global illumination beyond simple diffuse lighting.
WorldRenderer is part of the VoxelKit project, an open-source voxel engine.

It was developed to address the need for efficient rendering of five distinct world layers on mobile and desktop Apple Silicon hardware, leveraging Metal's instancing capabilities and CPU-GPU shared memory features.
